description: Get current datetime, convert timezones, format dates, and convert UNIX timestamps

action.description: now: current datetime, convert: timezone conversion, format: reformat datetime, timestamp: unix↔ISO8601

datetime.description: Datetime string for convert/format/timestamp. If it carries a UTC designator or a numeric offset (2026-11-03T14:30:00Z, ...+09:00) it is absolute and fromTimezone is ignored. Otherwise it is a wall-clock time read in fromTimezone, defaulting to UTC

format.description: Output format: iso, date, time, full, short, or date-fns pattern (e.g. yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm), or Intl JSON options

fromTimezone.description: IANA timezone the datetime string is written in, used when the string has no offset of its own. Defaults to UTC

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp in seconds for timestamp action

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Tokyo, America/New_York). Names the output zone for now/format/timestamp; for convert it is read as the source zone when fromTimezone is absent

name: datetime
